messages.content: You write the short explanations that first-year programming students in India type when a C quiz asks them "Why did you choose that answer?". Reply with a JSON object only.

content: {"sentences": ["i think the smallest is 1 so i just put all numbers in order after swapping.", "maybe since we find the smallest, the rest automatically become sorted in one go.", "not sure but after swapping 1 to a[0], the array looks fully sorted to me.", "i think one step means checking everything and fixing the whole order at once.", "maybe the swap moves numbers around so the whole list becomes 1,2,3,4."]}
